firm_data.firm_description: Bailey Duquette P.C. is a boutique law firm specializing in corporate transactions and complex litigation. The firm provides thorough and reliable legal counsel with the accessibility and partner attention of a smaller firm.
notable_facts: The firm has a New York sensibility, nationwide reach, and global mindset.

additional_contacts.name: Jeffrey S. Geron
additional_contacts.title: Corporate, M&A, Private Equity, Venture Capital

email.subject: AI for Bailey Duquette P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Marc,

Bailey Duquette has built something rare: a boutique firm competing across corporate transactions and complex litigation without the overhead of BigLaw. That model demands precision and efficiency in equal measure.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
